title: Ingest
description: Output of `rulekit ingest`. Two modes. With --rule: one stored rule's condition read back — `converted` true = rulekit fully modeled every construct (an ordinary AST, ready for explain/diff); false = a tolerant Opaque passthrough preserving the kernel's text verbatim. With --all: the unified whole-model read — `rules` and `computations` (disjoint maps keyed by full name; a computation is stored as a rule in the kernel's getAllRules() but is reported only under `computations`) plus a `summary`.

converted.description: (--rule) true = Converted (full rulekit AST); false = Opaque (verbatim passthrough)

condition.description: (--rule, Converted) the rendered DSL of the condition

canonicalText.description: (--rule, Opaque) the raw kernel condition text, preserved verbatim

rules.description: (--all) validation rules keyed by full name; each value is a per-rule outcome

computations.description: (--all) computations keyed by full name; each value is a per-computation outcome

fullyTyped.description: every rule and computation converted to a typed AST
